observation: Target code compares DL with 80h, intercepts AH 02h and 0Ah, and otherwise jumps through an existing far vector, corresponding to the reference disk I/O interception path. The old diagnostic data definitions reached BIOS offsets 0540h-0542h.
change: Exclude legacy padding, dsktnum and nextspeed from DOS7_CONFIG. Keep dsktnum as an explicit compatibility stub for the unchanged reference msinit object.
limitations: This identifies executable target bytes at the old diagnostic positions, not the final location or existence of every corresponding disk-state variable. The target handler and whole segment layout remain unreconstructed.
